messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I summarized remediation items and owners, want to lock timelines before EOD. TL;DR: improve canary auto-rollback, tighten flag scopes, add recurring regression alert.

sam: Actions I propose (short):
- A1: Auto-rollback policy: add explicit latency/error thresholds + cooldowns (owner: devon)
- A2: Blast-radius matrix: enforce per-release flag scope + runtime quota (owner: tara)
- A3: Post-deploy smoke tests: lightweight traffic tests & synthetic checks (owner: lee)
- A4: Recurring incident pattern alerting: weekly signal rollup and anomaly detection (owner: maria)
- A5: Runbook updates + ownership rotation for 90 days (owner: ashley)

sam: For each item propose: owner, acceptance criteria, ETA (days). please ack and send ETA.

tara: ack — can do blast-radius matrix. ETA 7 working days for first draft. Acceptance: flag metadata enforced at deploy-time + a SLICE check that warns if scope > threshold.

devon: on auto-rollback. agree on thresholds, but need to validate interactions with canary sampling. ETA 10 days to prototype policy & add unit tests. Acceptance: canary rollout auto-fires and reverses within SLO on synthetic failure in staging.

lee: smoke tests — can reuse existing perf harness. ETA 5 days to wire into deploy pipeline. Acceptance: deploy pipeline blocks on smoke-test failure for non-trivial model changes.

maria: pattern alerts — I'll wire up a weekly job to aggregate postmortem tags + telemetry. ETA 8 days. Acceptance: alert surfaces top 3 recurring regression signals to #incidents.

ashley: runbooks — I'll create templated remediation steps and rotate oncall ownership quarterly. ETA 6 days. Acceptance: runbooks linked from incident page and assigned owner.

ops-bot: deploybot created epic EPIC-4856 and linked A1,A2,A3,A4,A5 as sub-tasks.

sam: thanks. couple of notes: 1) devon — make sure auto-rollback doesn't thrash for low-volume canaries; include a minimum-window + cooldown. 2) tara — add a conservative default for flag scope to avoid mass rollout by mistake.

devon: noted. will add cooldown window and min-sample checks. also will add simulation harness to validate non-thrashing.

tara: will add default global scope = "team-only" unless escalated. also add tooling to require a justification string for broader scopes.

maria: for alerts — can we include a delta from baseline metric so ops can prioritize?

sam: yes, include delta + confidence band. keep priority <= P2 for initial rollout.

ashley: scheduling a 30min sync Thursday to review drafts. proposing 11am PT.

lee: works for me.

devon: can do.

tara: yep.

maria: ok.

sam: great — I'll capture these in the postmortem follow-up doc and ping owners with the epic link. please update EPIC-4856 subtasks with exact acceptance criteria by tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:

ashley: noted. I'll add runbook template in that epic and assign reviewers.

ops-bot: reminder: weekly follow-up cadence created. Next check-in in 7 days.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for postmortem follow-ups and action item tracking focused on rollout/canary/feature-flag improvements.
